parsed.explanation: Visitor risk is high but not catastrophic. Same-sex/gross-indecency laws and a documented state-directed LGBTI crackdown—committee to identify/punish, forced anal exams, custody torture—give police a lever and normalize severe violence. A recent trans activist was abducted, beaten and mutilated, and international reports describe escalating anti-LGBT/transphobic climate and official website blocking. No functioning protection or recourse is documented; partner recognition and resident healthcare language are climate signals only. The dossier lacks evidence that trans visitors are systematically stopped at borders or that execution/near-certain imprisonment is the usual outcome, and trans-specific universal facility/custody rules are undocumented, so it sits above severe-risk anchors with registry/custody campaigns and below jurisdictions where hostility is merely social. Uncertainty: older campaigns and missing current trans-specific enforcement.
